run_generate_go_protobufs: run the script to generate Go protobuf files from Bazel go_proto_library rules and copy them to the workspace go directory
build_go_protobufs_with_bazel: build all go_proto_library targets using Bazel fastbuild configuration and extract the generated Go source files
query_go_proto_library_rules: query the Bazel workspace for all go_proto_library rules and their dependencies using bazel query
copy_generated_go_files: copy generated Go protobuf files from the Bazel bin output directory to a custom output directory with proper permissions
review_generateProtobufs_function: review the generateProtobufs function that queries Bazel for Go proto rules, builds them, and copies generated files to an output directory
